# Swabi

> Swabi is a UK crypto tax specialist practice. It helps individuals and businesses
> work out and report the tax due on cryptoassets to HMRC, put right previous years,
> and plan ahead. Founded and led by Sham Sadiq, a qualified Chartered Management
> Accountant with 6+ years of crypto tax experience.

## Who we help
- Individuals with crypto: investors, traders, and people earning from staking, mining, airdrops, DeFi or NFTs
- Businesses that receive, pay, hold, trade or pay dividends in crypto

## Services
- Crypto Tax Returns (individuals): capital gains calculations, income from staking, mining and airdrops, NFT transactions, HMRC-compliant reporting and full Self Assessment support
- Crypto for Businesses: receiving and paying in crypto, dividends via crypto, trading profit calculations, Corporation Tax reporting, bookkeeping for crypto transactions, guidance on HMRC treatment
- Crypto Diagnostic: full review of wallets, exchanges and DeFi activity, checked against HMRC rules, with a clear action plan, timeline and cost to become compliant
- Full Portfolio & Wallet Reconciliation: wallet and exchange review, identification of taxable events, highlighting missed reporting, voluntary disclosures to HMRC
- Backdated Reporting: reconstruction of historical data, support with HMRC enquiries
- Tax Planning & Advice: timing disposals, using losses, structuring investments tax-efficiently, planning for future tax bills

## How it works
1. Free, no-obligation discovery call
2. Client onboarding
3. Data collection and analysis across exchanges, wallets and blockchains
4. Transaction reconciliation
5. Tax review and planning in line with HMRC guidance
6. Quality control and verification
7. Report delivery and support

## Where we work
Clients across the United Kingdom.
